title: DGTL Studios × DGTL Records — The Room and the Machine
audience: A working Toronto sound engineer who owns a full professional recording, mixing and mastering chain but no room, considering a lease on the lower-level Unit B3 at 20 Maud Street from Strashin Developments.
offer: He signs the lease and keeps the gear, the engineering and his existing clients. DGTL brings the brand identity, the website and booking system, a client pipeline out of DGTL's own production work, and DGTL Records as the registration, publishing and rights back end — paid on the work DGTL originates plus a build fee.
